title: Two sessions out of five and zero leg work in 14 days is not a program, it's a habit of skipping.
summary:
Sessions: 2 of 5 this week (Pull · Muscle Oct 12, Upper · Strength Oct 17). Last week was 1 of 5 (Push Oct 10). That is two weeks running under half your target. Your last leg session was Oct 3 and lasted 17 minutes; Lower · Strength was last done Oct 2. Since then: 4 upper sessions, 0 lower.
Strength: bench is moving. 185x9 on Oct 10 (e1RM ~241) and 185x8 today (~234), up from 155x12 on Oct 1 (~217). Rows went backwards: 145x8 on Oct 12 (~184) to 115x10 today (~153). Seated DB press dropped from 27.5x12x3 (Oct 10) to 20x10x3. Smith bench flat at 185x8 two sessions running. Today ran 70 min against a 60-min target.
Food: 1 of 7 days logged, and that day shows 327 kcal and 33 g protein against a ~170 g target. Fruit/veg not logged. Weigh-ins: 166.5 (Oct 10) to 170.0 (Oct 17), +3.5 lb in a week off two single readings. That's noise until you weigh in more often.
Watch: only Oct 16 synced. 4,078 steps (standard 7,500), 45 active kcal, RHR 70, HRV 44, VO2 max 33.3, which is low for 29. Sleep not recorded.
wins: Bench up ~17 lb e1RM in 16 days: 155x12 to 185x9, and 185x8 held today.
Chin-ups and pulldowns are getting done: 3x8-10 chin-ups and 2x12 at 88 lb on neutral pulldown today.
You finished a stair-climber block in every session you did (5-10 min).
misses: Legs: 0 lower-body sessions in 14 days. Lower · Strength last done Oct 2, Legs · Muscle Oct 3 (17 min, 5 sets).
Rep ranges ignored: bench is prescribed 4x3-5 @RPE 8; you did 6 sets of 4-10 at RPE 10. Rows prescribed 5x5-7; you did 5x8-10.
Barbell row regressed: 145x8 (Oct 12) to 115x10 (Oct 17), e1RM ~184 to ~153.
Seated DB press regressed: 27.5x12x3 to 20x10x3. Barbell OHP was the prescribed lift and wasn't done.
Skipped prescribed accessories today: hammer curl + overhead triceps extension (swapped for incline curl, no triceps work).
Nutrition: 1/7 days logged. Logged day: 327 kcal, 33 g protein (~170 g target). Fruit/veg: not logged.
Weigh-ins: 1 this week. Need 3+ to read a trend.
Steps: 4,078 on the one day synced (target 7,500). 6 days not synced.
Logging errors: neutral pulldown set 3 at 0 lb; chin-up load jumped from 30 to 60 with no note on whether that's added or assisted weight.
changes: Removed Smith machine bench (3x8-12) from Upper · Strength. You already bench barbell first; the second flat press made today 70 min and added nothing new. Session should land near 60 min now.
Added a 10-15 min stair-climber finisher to Pull · Muscle. VO2 max is 33.3; you're already doing short blocks, this makes it prescribed and longer on your shortest day.
Kept 5 days. You've missed more than half two weeks running, but the fix is showing up, not a smaller plan. Your next session in the app is Lower · Strength. Do it.
focus: Hit 5 sessions, and do both leg days first: Lower · Strength next, Legs · Muscle within 3 days of it. No upper session until Lower · Strength is logged.
Use the prescribed ranges: bench 4x3-5 and row 5x5-7 at RPE 8. That means 1-2 reps left in the tank, not grinding to failure. Start bench at 195-200 for 4x4 and row at 135 for 5x6.
Log food every day. Hit 150+ g protein minimum, aiming for ~170. One shake isn't a day of eating.
Weigh in 3 mornings this week (same conditions: after bathroom, before food) and keep the Watch syncing daily, including sleep.
Take front, side and back photos this week: same spot, same light, morning.
photos: No progress photos on file. Take front, side and back this week under the same lighting and time of day. Without a baseline I can't tell you whether you're getting leaner or just heavier.
